specs.Item Type Name: 32 Inch NON SMART HD Ready LED Television

features: HD Ready 32 Inch Display – Enjoy clear picture quality with bright visuals, natural colours and sharp details, suitable for daily TV viewing, movies, news, sports and entertainment.
Non Smart TV for Simple Use – Designed for users who want a reliable normal LED TV without apps or WiFi. Perfect for set top box, CCTV monitor, gaming console, USB media and office display use.
30W Powerful Sound Output – Built-in high-output speakers deliver louder and clearer audio for movies, music, news and daily entertainment without needing an external speaker.
HDMI & USB Connectivity – Easily connect set top box, laptop, gaming console, CCTV DVR, pen drive and media devices using HDMI and USB ports for flexible everyday use.
Slim Bezel Premium Design – Modern narrow-bezel look gives a bigger screen feel and blends well in living room, bedroom, shop, office, hotel room or security room setup.
Ideal for Multiple Uses – Best choice for home entertainment, CCTV camera monitoring, office display, gaming, hotel rooms, shops, classrooms and budget-friendly daily viewing.
